thread:
oliver: Hi folks  due date is Nov 2. I'm planning parental leave: 2 weeks before, 10 weeks after. I'm remote (US) but partner will be on EU payroll. Quick Qs: when do I need to submit paperwork to avoid payroll hiccups, how does tax withholding work if partner is EU, and what's required for dependent enrollment?

camille: Congrats! :tada: Short answers: submit parental leave request in the HR portal as soon as you have an approximate date (we recommend 30 days). For pay coordination: your leave pay is processed on your payroll only  we don't transfer pay across countries. Your partner's EU payroll will handle their own leave. For dependent enrollment, add the child within 30 days in the benefits portal so coverage starts immediately.

oliver: Got it. So no cross-pay. Anything special on taxes for the US if my partner is on EU payroll and will be the primary caregiver?

marta: Taxes are based on the payroll that pays the wages. If you're paid by US payroll during your leave, normal US withholding applies. If your partner is paid by EU payroll, their tax treatment follows local rules. If both of you are Redwood employees and splitting weeks, each payroll handles its share and tax accordingly. If you need a split schedule, indicate the other employee's name in your parental request so People Ops can reconcile records.

oliver: What about the company top-up? We plan to split company-paid weeks between us. How does that get applied?

camille: Company top-up is applied by each employee's local payroll. Example: if Redwood provides 8 company-paid weeks for primary caregivers and you split 4/4, US payroll will apply 4 weeks to you and EU payroll will apply 4 weeks to your partner. Each payroll will calculate local tax and benefits impacts.

oliver: For paperwork: do I need STD, FMLA, physician note? Timeline?
marta: For US: submit parental leave request, STD claim (if using STD) with physician's due-date certification, and FMLA packet if you want job protection and are eligible. To avoid payroll delays, get leave request + STD confirmation in at least 10 business days before payroll cutoff. Our payroll cutoffs are the 1st and 15th of the month.

payroll-bot: AUTOMATED: "Parental leave request received for oliver (thread 1765432100). Please upload supporting docs: physician's due date confirmation, STD claim number (if applicable), and dependent enrollment documentation after birth."

oliver: Thanks  I'll submit the leave request and physician note today. One last: does equity vesting continue during company-paid leave?

marta: Yes, company-paid parental leave counts as payroll for vesting. If you take unpaid time beyond the company-paid period, submit LOA so comp can confirm vesting treatment.

camille: Ops note: please add a 1-page runbook with active PRs, releases, and an "alerts & escalation" snippet. If you need a short-term contractor, include dates and skills and hiring-ops can route a vendor quickly.

oliver: Uploaded the runbook and leave request. Appreciate the help :)
